blocks.c: Books worth reading are mostly too long for one sitting. That is not a flaw in books; it is a flaw in sittings. So the real test of a reading app is not the page — any app can draw a page — but the seams between sittings: the closing, the week away, the coming back.

Here is what this app does at the seams. Your place is saved continuously, to the paragraph, without being asked — you have been reading the proof for six chapters. Every book keeps its own place, so pausing a doorstop novel to inhale a short serial costs neither of them anything. And when you come back to the home screen, the book you were reading is waiting at the very top, in a rail called Continue reading, one tap from the sentence you left.

Each book also remembers how you like it. The mode, the type, the theme you set in chapters two through four belong to this book; another book can be arranged another way, and each remembers its own arrangement for as long as it sits on the shelf. A dense reference in small mono, a serial in large warm serif — the app keeps both rooms made up.

Then there is the matter in the app's own name. A book from the catalogue or from a source arrives chapter by chapter, over the network, as you read. But networks are for cities, and books are for planes, tents, basements and trains. On any series page you will find a download control beside each chapter, and one for the lot. Saved chapters live on your device and open with no connection at all — and the series page counts them for you, so before a flight you can see at a glance how much of the book is truly aboard.

The files you imported in chapter five are already fully yours, of course — they came in whole. And this tutorial, along with its six classic companions, is built into the app itself: the floor of the shelf, readable on a bare device in a dead zone with the last bar of signal long gone.
An offline reader is a promise about the worst day, not the best one: no signal, no server, no account — and still the book opens.

There is nothing you need to practice in this chapter, unless a flight is imminent, in which case we recommend the download button and a long book. Read on; the next chapter is about time itself, and it has been keeping some numbers for you.
